gloss: inside the premises; on the grounds

definitions.gloss: inside the premises; on the grounds; within the property
definitions.explanation: The area within the boundaries of a piece of land or property. Used to describe the interior space of a compound, campus, building site, or other defined area.

examples.japanese: {敷地内|しきちない}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧です。
examples.english: Smoking is prohibited on the premises.

examples.japanese: {敷地内|しきちない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a parking lot on the grounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧{敷地内|しきちない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}る→立ち入る：26367_tachiiru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Entering the premises without permission is prohibited.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{敷地|しきち}→敷地：00365_shikichi⟧ (grounds, premises, site) and ⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ (inside, within). Commonly seen on signs and in official notices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敷地内|しきちない}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧: no smoking on the premises
- {敷地内|しきちない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the premises
- {敷地内|しきちない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}る→立ち入る：26367_tachiiru⟧: to set foot on the premises
- {敷地内|しきちない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: facilities on the grounds

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{敷地|しきち}→敷地：00365_shikichi⟧: premises / grounds — the base word without the "inside" suffix
- {敷地外|しきちがい}: outside the premises — the opposite
- {構内|こうない}: inside a compound or campus — similar meaning, often used for stations and campuses
- {場内|じょうない}: inside a venue — used for event spaces and halls

REGISTER:
Neutral to formal. Frequently appears on signs, rules, and official documents.
